title: Publish scheduler claim-composition surface on @moe/scheduler root
description:
Objective: make the scheduler authority and budget claim-composition surface reachable from outside @moe/scheduler, so apps/daemon can compose it. Blocker-fix task 1 of 2, created by architect-8a4a1764 on 2026-08-08 under human approval in the REPL, after task-ba3a45f9 (Daemon work services, SPIDR child 3) was found unbuildable from its owned paths.

WHY THIS EXISTS - evidence, probed not assumed, from apps/daemon with both controls:
  node --experimental-strip-types -e "import('@moe/scheduler/authority/lease-resource.js')"
    -> DEEP FAIL ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED
  node --experimental-strip-types -e "import('@moe/scheduler')"
    -> ROOT OK exports=17
The 17 root exports are ALL graph-kernel (validateGraphSnapshot, analyzeGraphStructure, analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals, partitionFrontier, previewGraphSnapshot, resolveGraphPolicy, createTraversalCounter, GraphAnalysisError, and 9 graph policy constants). packages/scheduler/package.json pins "exports": {".": "./src/index.ts"}, which is an EXCLUSIVE map: no subpath import resolves, at runtime or under moduleResolution NodeNext. So reserveAll / reserveProviderSlot / fenceAuthority / the budget reservation records are unreachable from every package except scheduler itself. Verified zero external consumers today: the only mention of fenceAuthority outside packages/scheduler is a COMMENT in packages/runner/src/supervisor/lease-mirror.ts:33.

Deliverable: extend packages/scheduler/src/index.ts with the claim-composition surface, following the file's existing export style (value exports grouped by module, then a `export type { ... }` block, all specifiers written with the .js extension per NodeNext). Minimum symbol set, driven by what task-ba3a45f9's four-leg atomic claim needs:
  - from ./authority/lease-resource.js : reserveAll, reserveProviderSlot, adapterConfirm, adapterFail, grantSuccessorCapacity + the AuthorityOutcome / ReserveAllResult / ProviderSlotReservation / AcquisitionSet types
  - from ./authority/lease-fencing.js  : fenceAuthority, parseLeaseRecord, parseProof, parseClock + the Fenced type
  - from ./authority/resource-model.js : SLOT_STATES, SlotState and the acquisition row types the above signatures name
  - from ./budget/budget-reservation.js: reserveForAdmission, activateReservation, cancelReservation, deriveReservationId, ADMISSION_PURPOSES, PROTECTED_ADMISSION_PURPOSES, ADMISSION_PURPOSE_RESERVE_CONTRACT, RESERVATION_STATES, BUDGET_RESERVATION_ISSUE_CODES + BudgetAvailableView, AdmissionRequest, AdmissionGate, ReservationRecord, ReservationState, BudgetReservationResult, BudgetReservationIssueCode and the command types
Add whatever transitive types those signatures reference (from ./authority/authority-kernel.js and ./budget/budget-contract.js) so a consumer can name every parameter and every branch of every return type without a deep import. Update the index.ts header docblock: its current "pure structural graph-analysis kernel" summary stops being the whole truth once authority and budget ship on the same entry point.

NO new .js bridges are needed here - verified: every module under packages/scheduler/src/authority/ and packages/scheduler/src/budget/ already has its tracked one-line sibling bridge (mem:gotcha-scheduler-js-shims). This task must not create, delete, or edit any bridge.

NOT in scope: changing any authority or budget BEHAVIOUR; adding a slot-count ceiling (design 427's four-slot project-wide limit is deliberately absent from reserveProviderSlot, which validates one slot and does no counting - the counting belongs to the daemon caller and is task-ba3a45f9's work); touching packages/runner; touching apps/daemon; any package.json or lockfile edit.

Hard dependencies: none. The authority children (lease presence core task-967769ea) and all five conserved-budget children are DONE. This task is independent of supervisor SPIDR children 1 and 2 and can start immediately.

Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/index.ts, packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts (new).
Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck
definitionOfDone: Every symbol named in the description is exported from packages/scheduler/src/index.ts, and a consumer can name every parameter type and every union branch of every exported function's return type without any deep subpath import.

A new packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts imports the package ROOT specifier @moe/scheduler (never a relative or deep path) and asserts, per symbol, that the export is present and of the expected typeof - so a dropped export fails the suite by name rather than by a vague count.

The same test pins the surface against silent loss: it asserts set equality between Object.keys of the namespace and a hand-written expected export list, so both a removed export AND an unreviewed addition go red. The list is hand-transcribed, never derived from the namespace under test (mem:gotcha-self-derived-universe-cannot-check-itself).

A plain-Node probe run from the repo root proves the new surface actually loads outside vitest, with BOTH controls recorded in the completion evidence: import('@moe/scheduler') resolves and its namespace contains reserveProviderSlot and fenceAuthority (positive), and a deep subpath import still raises ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED (negative control proving the exports map stayed exclusive). A vitest-only gate is not evidence the module loads (mem:gotcha-vitest-hides-missing-js-bridge).

Zero behaviour change: no non-test file under packages/scheduler/src/authority/ or packages/scheduler/src/budget/ is modified, no .js bridge is added or edited, and the pre-existing scheduler suite passes with the same test count as before this task.

pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck exits 0; committed paths are exactly packages/scheduler/src/index.ts and packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts.
taskRails: Re-export only. This task changes what is REACHABLE, never what any function DOES. If a symbol seems to need a signature change to be exportable, stop and report_blocked rather than editing authority or budget logic.
Do not add, remove, or edit any .js bridge - packages/scheduler/src/authority/** and budget/** are already fully bridged, and an unnecessary bridge edit is an unowned change to shared runtime state.
Assert the reason code, not just the outcome: the exclusive-exports negative control must assert the literal ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED, never merely that the deep import failed.

Keep the production file focused: target <=250 lines, split before 400. packages/scheduler/src/index.ts is 81 lines today - if the added surface would push it past 250, extract the authority/budget re-exports into a sibling module that index.ts re-exports, rather than letting the entry point sprawl.

Commit by explicit pathspec only: git commit -- packages/scheduler/src/index.ts packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts. Never a bare git commit; the index is shared across concurrent tasks (epic rail 3).
